title: Image editing joins gptimage
summary:
gptimage gained image editing and quality controls, alongside its existing image generation path.

The gptimage integration now edits an existing image when one is supplied and generates a new image when it is not. Image inputs can come from URLs, file paths, base64 data, or buffers. Requests also accept low, medium, high, or hd quality; gptimage requests now use the image queue even with a valid token.

daily.title: Edit images with gptimage
daily.text: Send an image with a `gptimage` request to edit it; leave the image out to generate one from scratch. Inputs can be URLs, file paths, base64 data, or buffers. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose image quality
daily.text: Set `gptimage` quality to `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `hd` to suit what you're making. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
